roadmap.title: Norbert OTel Setup Command and Post-Install Guidance
roadmap.note: Deliverables are Markdown files. Claude is the runtime. No application code is written.

rejected_simple_alternatives.expected_impact: 0% — silently ignored by Claude Code for env activation
rejected_simple_alternatives.why_insufficient: This is the exact bug the feature fixes. Confirmed by official Claude Code plugin docs.

rejected_simple_alternatives.expected_impact: ~20% — users who re-read README after install
rejected_simple_alternatives.why_insufficient: README is passive and forgotten after install. No validation safety net for manual edits. No in-context discoverability.

steps.title: Create CLAUDE.md at plugin root
steps.description: Write CLAUDE.md at plugin root. Content: what Norbert is (one sentence), that OTel setup is required, the exact command /norbert:setup, and that Norbert must be running first.
acceptance_criteria: CLAUDE.md exists at plugin root alongside .claude-plugin/, hooks/, .mcp.json
File contains the exact string /norbert:setup
User-visible content is fewer than 10 lines
File does not reproduce README content verbatim
File states Norbert must be running before setup has effect
architectural_constraints: File at plugin root — not inside .claude-plugin/ or any subdirectory
Command name /norbert:setup must match the commands/setup.md filename

steps.title: Write commands/setup.md — happy path and idempotent path
steps.description: Write commands/setup.md. Instructions cover: resolve ~, read settings.json, parse JSON, compare 5 OTel keys, merge missing keys into env block, write back, report with + prefix per added key, confirm restart required.
acceptance_criteria: Running /norbert:setup on a fresh settings.json writes all 5 OTel keys with correct names and values
All pre-existing keys in settings.json are unchanged after the write
Command output lists each added key with + prefix and instructs restart
Re-running /norbert:setup when all 5 keys are already correct makes no changes and reports = prefix for each key
env block is created if absent; no other top-level key is added or removed
architectural_constraints: Target is ~/.claude/settings.json — not the plugin-local settings.json
~ must be resolved to OS home directory ($HOME / %USERPROFILE%)
Merge is surgical: only the 5 canonical keys are touched

steps.title: Add conflict detection and --force support to commands/setup.md
steps.description: Extend setup.md instructions: detect per-key value conflicts, display current vs. Norbert value for each conflicting key, write nothing on any conflict, offer --force and manual-edit recovery paths. --force writes all 5 keys regardless of conflicts.
acceptance_criteria: A conflicting key triggers a warning showing key name, current value, and Norbert's intended value
No write occurs when any key has a conflict (without --force)
Output instructs user to re-run with --force or edit manually
/norbert:setup --force writes all 5 keys and marks overwritten keys with ! prefix
Keys already at the correct value are shown as = (not flagged as conflicts) even during a --force run
architectural_constraints: Conflict check is per-key string equality — no partial match logic
All-or-nothing write on clean run: no partial writes of non-conflicting keys

steps.title: Add malformed JSON bail path to commands/setup.md
steps.description: Extend setup.md instructions: if settings.json is missing or cannot be parsed as valid JSON, bail immediately with a human-readable error and recovery steps. Do not write anything.
acceptance_criteria: Malformed JSON produces a human-readable error message — no raw stack trace
settings.json is not modified on JSON parse failure
Error output provides recovery steps: open file, validate at jsonlint.com, re-run after fixing
Missing file scenario is explained with the creation option (echo '{}' > ~/.claude/settings.json)
Command output mentions Claude Code auto-backup on successful write paths
architectural_constraints: Bail immediately — no attempt to repair or partially parse malformed JSON
File must remain byte-for-byte identical after bail

steps.title: Update README.md to document the setup command
steps.description: Add a Setup section to README documenting /norbert:setup, clarifying that the plugin-local settings.json does not activate OTel, and noting the restart requirement.
acceptance_criteria: README contains a section documenting /norbert:setup and its purpose
README notes that plugin-local settings.json env vars are not the activation mechanism
README states that Claude Code must be restarted after running /norbert:setup
architectural_constraints: Do not remove existing README content — append or insert only

unchanged_files: settings.json (plugin root — retained as reference, no modification)

quality_gates: CLAUDE.md command name matches commands/setup.md filename (/norbert:setup)
All 5 OTel keys match canonical values from shared-artifacts-registry.md exactly
~ expansion handled for both Unix ($HOME) and Windows (%USERPROFILE%)
No write occurs on malformed JSON or any key conflict (without --force)
settings.json merge is surgical — non-target keys are preserved
integration_checkpoints: settings_json_path resolves to user home — not plugin root
otel_env_keys canonical names and values used verbatim in command instructions
